Deltas are read from the same all-current-records stats the report tables show (not the conditioned subset). Red-before for test_pick cases was an ImportError (against/incumbent/pick_line missing) and for test_run cases a TypeError on the new tiers kwarg. No ADR (card names CHANGELOG as the only shared surface).
notes: The scripted FakeModel bench clears no config's floor (sonnet-low 1 repeat, opus-medium accuracy 57.1), so the CLI-level tests exercise the fallback path; the non-fallback incumbent->proposed diff is covered by the unit tests in test_pick.py. No sibling reds seen. Real src/athena/adopt/tiers.json untouched.
